nom: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Micellar Cleansing Water

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin report the product removes makeup without leaving a greasy or oily residue and does not cause breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it cleans without stripping, tightness, or dryness, leaving skin soft and hydrated.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as gentle and effective without over-drying, used alongside other cleansers.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea, most often report no irritation, burning, or redness, though a smaller group says the fragrance makes their eyes burn or their skin itchy and dry.
segments.mature: An older reviewer with minimal dryness and another 43-year-old with sensitive, rosacea-prone skin both describe it as gentle and non-irritating.
segments.normal: A few reviewers without a stated skin condition simply describe it as a good, gentle daily cleansing step with no adverse effects.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer reports the product is gentle with minimal dryness on aging skin; no anti-aging effect is claimed by anyone.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it leaves skin hydrated, soft, and not stripped or tight; one reviewer with dry skin explicitly notes no tightness or dryness after use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea or reactive skin report no redness or flare-ups, and one switched from Garnier specifically because that brand caused redness; a small number instead describe redness and irritation around the eyes from this product.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe it as non-stripping and calming to the skin barrier, with no reports of barrier damage.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers prone to acne, cysts, or clogged pores report fewer breakouts, less clogging, and no new blackheads/whiteheads; one reviewer explicitly says it caused an acne flare-up.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report the product does not cause breakouts and helps reduce clogged pores; one dissenting reviewer reports increased acne after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report no greasy or oily residue after use; no reviewer states it increases oiliness.

extraits.texte: The fragrance in this makeup remover is very strong and it made my skin very dry, itchy, and sensitive around my eyes. I also developed little bumps on the top of my cheeks. The brand is so well reviewed I thought I would love this product. I will be sticking to garnier or cleansing balms.

extraits.titre: LA ROCHE POSAY MICELLAR WATER ULTRA
extraits.texte: My skin is sensitive and acne prone and this product has really been a game changer for my skin care routine. This product is gentle and never irritated my skin.

I have rosacea so my skin is very sensitive and reactive. This was recommended to me by my pharmacist in France. I was hesitant to use it at first just because other micellar waters didn't work for me, but I'm so glad I did. I either use it on its own or as the first step of a double cleanse on days that I wear extra sunscreen and/or tinted moisturizer. When I use it on its own, I usually spritz my face with thermal water and pat dry, or give it a light rinse from the faucet. But I know people who don't rinse it off at all. Do whatever works best fo your skin type. In any case, it's amazing stuff. It cleans well and feels wonderful!

extraits.titre: The best makeup remover for sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: For starters, I am 43, I have very sensitive skin, rosacea, acne- everything! This doesn't irritate my skin and it does what it claims. Great product.

My skin is oily, sensitive, and acne-prone. I have many closed comedones and do get cysts from time to time especially along my jawline. The jawline area tends to get super dry easily (peeling, flaking) if I overdo a product or use a product that's too strong. I've tried several micellar waters for my skin and it's always a longer process to get my long-wear foundation off. This product is definitely more efficient and really pulls the makeup out of your skin without irritating or over-drying. I cannot speak for the mascara removal as I only use one product to remove my mascara due to extremely sensitive eyes, so I have not even tried to use this on my eyes in fear of them getting irritated. Bonus: it smells very lightly of crisp, sweet Bartlett pears. Seems to be the best makeup remover for my oily, acne prone skin - no residual makeup so no whiteheads/blackheads/cysts etc. Great product!
Wanted to like this, removed my eye makeup fently and effectively. Caused acne to flair up, whether product was left on or cleansed off skin.
This makes my skin feel smooth and soft! I have super dry skin but this makes my skin feel great afterward! It does a great job of removing most of my makeup!
